text: Those fans are disgusting idiots and should be banned.
The club condemned a post calling its fans disgusting idiots who should be banned.
Calling the fans disgusting idiots is unfair and wrong.
Immigrants are worthless and we hate them here.
Police are investigating leaflets claiming immigrants are worthless.
Nobody is worthless, and saying immigrants are is hateful.
Politicians are lying scumbags who should all be thrown out.
A survey found many voters describe politicians as lying scumbags.
It is lazy and unfair to call all politicians lying scumbags.
Vegans are annoying freaks and nobody likes them.
The article quoted a comment calling vegans annoying freaks.
Vegans are not annoying freaks, they just eat differently.
Teenagers are useless brats who ruin everything.
The headteacher criticised an advert that called teenagers useless brats.
Teenagers are not useless brats and deserve respect.
My neighbours are filthy pigs and I hate them.
The court heard the defendant called his neighbours filthy pigs.
It was cruel of him to call his neighbours filthy pigs.
Refugees are parasites draining our country.
The report documents politicians describing refugees as parasites.
Refugees are not parasites, and that language dehumanises people.
Women are too stupid to drive.
Researchers studied online comments claiming women are too stupid to drive.
The idea that women are too stupid to drive is simply false.
Poor people are lazy losers who deserve nothing.
The charity condemned a tweet calling poor people lazy losers.
Poor people are not lazy losers, and that stereotype hurts.
That referee is a pathetic moron.
Fans were fined for chanting that the referee is a pathetic moron.
Shouting that the referee is a pathetic moron is unacceptable.
Gamers are smelly idiots.
A columnist was criticised for writing that gamers are smelly idiots.
Gamers are not smelly idiots, that is a lazy insult.
Tourists are disgusting and should stay away.
Locals put up signs saying tourists are disgusting, the paper reported.
It is wrong to say tourists are disgusting.
Cyclists are arrogant idiots and should be banned from roads.
The council received complaints calling cyclists arrogant idiots.
Cyclists are not arrogant idiots, most ride safely.
Students are lazy scroungers.
A headline describing students as lazy scroungers sparked complaints.
Students are not lazy scroungers, many work two jobs.
Rural people are dumb hicks.
The study found online posts calling rural people dumb hicks.
Rural people are not dumb hicks, that is a nasty stereotype.
Old people are useless and a burden.
The charity reported that older people are often told they are useless and a burden.
Old people are not useless or a burden.
